steps.title: Add GET /healthz route to Bun.serve handler
steps.description: Add a new if-branch in src/server/index.ts for pathname === '/healthz'. Return 200 with JSON { status: 'ok', uptime: process.uptime() }. Reject non-GET methods with 405.
acceptanceCriteria: GET /healthz returns 200 with JSON body containing 'status' and 'uptime'
Non-GET methods to /healthz return 405 with JSON { error: 'Method Not Allowed' }

steps.title: Add tests for /healthz endpoint
steps.description: Add test cases in tests/server.test.ts: GET /healthz returns 200 with correct body shape, POST /healthz returns 405, existing /hello tests still pass.
acceptanceCriteria: Test: GET /healthz returns 200 with { status: 'ok', uptime: number }
All existing server tests still pass

steps.title: Run test suite and verify all behavioral contracts
steps.description: Execute 'bun test tests/server.test.ts' and confirm all tests pass including the new /healthz tests.
acceptanceCriteria: All tests pass with zero failures
No regressions in existing /hello endpoint tests

behavioralContract.title: Health check returns status and uptime
behavioralContract.description: GET /healthz returns 200 with JSON { status: 'ok', uptime: <seconds as number> }
behavioralContract.evidence: bun test tests/server.test.ts — health check test passes

behavioralContract.title: Health check rejects non-GET methods
behavioralContract.description: POST/PUT/DELETE to /healthz return 405 with JSON { error: 'Method Not Allowed' }

decisions: Using Bun.serve() pathname routing pattern matching existing /hello endpoint
Including process.uptime() in response for basic observability
Reusing existing 405 method guard pattern from /hello
risks: process.uptime() leaks server start time (acceptable for internal health checks)
No authentication on health endpoint (standard practice for health checks)
